slices.objective: Issue #693 slice 5 also lists section agreement. Add one pure helper, in a new module of its own, taking reference sections and generated sections, each a list of [name, start_seconds] pairs, and a tolerance in seconds. It returns the fraction (a float from 0.0 to 1.0) of reference sections that can be paired with a distinct generated section of the same name (ignoring case) whose start is within the tolerance (inclusive). The pairing must be a MAXIMUM one-to-one matching, not first-come greedy pairing: use this algorithm, which is maximum for start times on a line. Group both lists by lower-cased name; within each name sort the reference starts and the generated starts ascending and walk both with two indexes: if the generated start is below reference minus tolerance, skip that generated section; if it is above reference plus tolerance, skip that reference section; otherwise pair them and advance both. The result is the number of pairs divided by the number of reference sections. A negative tolerance is treated as 0.0. When there are no reference sections the result is 0.0, because no agreement can be shown. No file access and no other behaviour.
